d: Bihar ke navada jile ke rupau thana kshetr antargat kasmara ganv men shadi ke mahaj char mahine bad ek navvivahita ka shav sandigdh paristhitiyon men phansi ke phande se latka milne se pure ilake men sanasni phail gaee hai. mritka ki pahchan 22 varshiy daulti kumari ke rup men huee hai, jiski shadi char mahine purv kasmara nivasi monu manjhi ke sath huee thi.
